name: snr_dark
description: Dark RAW frame sequence for sensor offset and temporal dark-noise measurement

geometry.depth_reference: Not applicable to stationary uniform-surface SNR measurement. Camera fixed at x=100 mm; paper distance not measured because depth is not being evaluated.

focus: Fixed lens focus and camera orientation
roi_definition: Central 400x400 RAW pixels: x=760:1160, y=340:740. Same sensor ROI as uniform-exposure sessions.
notes: Camera stationary at x=100 mm with the lens completely blocked using an opaque light-tight cover. Fixed exposure 32000 µs, analogue gain 4×, AE disabled. Capture 24 RAW dark frames with no light reaching the sensor. Room illumination left unchanged. Dark frames will be used to characterise sensor black-level offset and dark temporal fluctuations.
protocol_notes: Temporal RAW SNR needs fixed camera/lighting and a documented ROI; use separate uniform/dark sessions if needed.
